title: Italian Redcurrant Fritters
description: A sweet and tangy dessert inspired by Italian flavors, featuring crisp redcurrant fritters.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and cornstarch.
In a separate bowl, whisk together egg and almond extract.
Add the egg mixture to the dry ingredients and stir until a smooth batter forms.
Heat about 2-3 inches of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
When the oil is hot, drop tablespoon-sized balls of the batter into the oil.
Fry until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain fritters on paper towels and dust with powdered sugar.
